The `isAvailableLocale` method in the `LocaleUtils` class checks if a given locale is available by checking if it is contained in the `cAvailableLocaleSet`. Let's proceed with fault localization to identify the root cause of the NullPointerException in this method.
Title: Diagnosis
Details: The `isAvailableLocale` method in the `LocaleUtils` class directly uses the `cAvailableLocaleSet` field without initializing it. If the `availableLocaleSet` method is not called before using `cAvailableLocaleSet`, it will cause a NullPointerException. This aligns with the FindBugs report suggesting that `cAvailableLocaleSet` is not initialized in the constructor, leading to the NullPointerException when accessing it. To fix this issue, `cAvailableLocaleSet` should be properly initialized in the constructor of the `LocaleUtils` class.
